svg.title: Different indispensability rankings for the additive meter two plus three
svg.desc: Barlow-style ranks four zero three one two. SCAMP Clarence ranks four one three zero two. The ranks of pulses two and four are reversed.

path.aria-label: Five pulses in two unequal groups. Only the ranks of pulses 2 and 4 change.
Amber: the two positions that exchange rank
